title: Songbook and Bakery
author: Wendell Blackwood
blurb: Freya Almeida, a single parent running the town's only bookshop, believes second chances are for people with better timing. But when the person behind a decade of letters moves in next door, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade before the festival ends.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
